versions.changelog:
last-login-janitor 1.0.1

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md (no functional changes).
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
- Minor cleanup and clarification in project metadata and docs.

Initial release of **last-login-janitor**.

- Scans developer machines for large or stale artifacts (repos, venvs, node_modules, Docker images/volumes, caches, model files).
- Determines last-access/last-commit time and flags items as stale or protected using domain-aware signals.
- Ranks deletion candidates by size and produces a reviewable cleanup manifest and commands (no auto-deletion).
- Handles edge cases (dirty git worktrees, unpushed commits, active Docker containers, critical caches) for safe decision-making.
- Supports dry-run/scan-only mode and guides the review and cleanup workflow.
- Includes comprehensive documentation on artifact types, usage examples, common pitfalls, and verification checklist.
